newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips further, pressured by techs.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips further, pressured by techs.

text.p: Nasdaq shares slipped slightly on Friday as a broad selloff in technology stocks continued, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index dropped 3.65 points or 0.28 percent to an unofficial close fo 1311.78. The Dow industrials gained about 56 points to 7001.
"There's just more and more nervousness in the techs. The sector had just been battered lately and today is no exception," one trader said.
"Techs made some gains earlier the week that they just couldn't hold on to. Any advances the sector has made recently have been wiped clean," another trader said.
Cisco Systems Inc led the decline, falling 3-1/4 to 51-3/8 in heavy trading after Furman Selz trimmed earnings estimates.

Atmel Corp crumbled about 15 percent or 4-3/4 to 26-3/4 after the semiconductor company warned its first quarter results would fall below fourth quarter revenues. Atmel's woes also dragged down rival Microchip Technology Inc, which lost 6-5/16 to 29-1/4.
Overall, advancing issues slightly beat losers 2135 to 2121 on total volume of 646.8 million shares.
